title: New Security Installations: Route Customer Acceptance Before Activating Recurring Billing
summary: Connect installation acceptance to the correct recurring-billing start decision for security integrators.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Security installation handoffs should distinguish installation completion, customer acceptance and the commercial start of recurring billing. A workflow can collect the required evidence and route activation to the authorized owner. It should not assume that a technician closing a task means the customer accepted every deliverable or that a monitoring or service agreement is ready to bill. Use the actual contract requirements, approved start date and verified system action for the recurring service.


Explore the complete[fire, life-safety and security integrators integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fire-life-safety-security-integrators) for the systems and processes around this guide.
